title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Additional Drivers Carried Free and Charged
content:
Two published amounts govern additional drivers on the Car Rental Rate Classes: how many the class carries free of charge on the agreement, and what each driver beyond that count costs for each rental day.

| Rate class | Additional drivers carried free | Additional driver fee per day (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 0 | 15.00 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 0 | 13.50 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 1 | 12.00 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 1 | 10.00 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 2 | 9.00 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 2 | 0.00 |

The free count is the number of additional drivers carried free of charge on the agreement, and the fee is the charge per rental day for each additional driver beyond that free count, in US dollars.

*How many additional drivers does the Pay Now Standard Rate carry free?* None: its free count is 0, and each additional driver runs at 13.5 for each rental day. The Pay Now Saver Rate likewise carries none, at 15 a day.

*Which classes carry drivers free?* The Pay At Counter Flex Rate and the Inclusive Flex Rate each carry 1, at 12 and 10 a day beyond that; the Premium Inclusive Rate and the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate each carry 2, at 9 a day and at 0 a day respectively.
